faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ph.D. Research Fellow posts at Panjab University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Ph.D. Research Fellow positions at Panjab University is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Ph.D. Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Ph.D. Research Fellow positions announced by Panjab University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Pharm and M.Pharm degree with a minimum of 55% marks and have qualified in GATE/GPAT/Ph.D. Entrance Test or any National Entrance test.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Ph.D. Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 11,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Ph.D. Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Ph.D. Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an interview and evaluation of marks in B.Pharm/M.Pharm, GATE/GPAT score, publications, presentations, and patents.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Panjab University, which is https://uips.pu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the specific specializations for M.Pharm required?
faq.answer: The M.Pharm degree should be in related specializations to the post applied for, as mentioned in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: The job type is contractual, meaning it is for a fixed tenure and not a permanent government position.
